# befui

> Copy-paste React components (Radix + Tailwind 4 + CSS variables) with real motion, plus HRMS and marketing blocks. You own the files: add them with the CLI, then import from `@/components/ui/<name>`.

## Setup
- One time: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui init` (theme CSS, cn helper, AGENTS.md rules, .mcp.json)
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add <name> [name...]` or `add all`; blocks are `block:<name>`. It also installs npm packages and any befui files a component imports.
- Exact source of any component as JSON (files, deps, requires, example): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/<name>.json
- MCP: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui mcp` gives tools list_components, get_component, add_components
- Icons: our own set in `@/components/ui/icons`, e.g. `import { SearchIcon } from '@/components/ui/icons'`; no icon package needed
- Theme: CSS variables in index.css (--primary, --ring, --accent...). Dark mode = `dark` class on <html>. Use tokens (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border`), never hard-coded colors.
- Full catalog with a working example per component: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/llms-full.txt

## Rules that save a debugging round
- Wrap the app once in `<TooltipProvider>` (tooltip) and render `<Toaster />` once, then call `toast.success('Saved')` anywhere (toast).
- Sidebar, AppShell: put `SidebarProvider` above them. Dialog and Sheet are the same primitive; use `SheetContent` for a side drawer.
- Stateful inputs are controlled: pass `value` and `onChange` (or `checked` / `onCheckedChange` for checkbox and switch).
- Tables: `table` is bare parts for static layouts. `data-table` adds sort, filter, pagination, row selection (`selectable`, `bulkActions`), a column menu (`columnMenu`) and a sticky header (`maxHeight`); you pass rows and `Column[]`.
- Merge classes with `cn` from `@/lib/utils`. Edit copied files freely; `add <name> --force` overwrites local edits.

## Which component for what
- Show tabular data: table (static), data-table (sort/filter/select/paginate), permission-matrix (roles by permissions), heatmap, charts
- Hint or explain on hover: tooltip (title, shortcut, arrow), InfoTip and TruncatedText (both exported by tooltip), popover for richer content
- Pick a value: select, combobox, radio-group, segmented, chip, switch, checkbox, slider, calendar, date-picker, time-picker, color-picker
- Type text or numbers: input, search-input, search-bar, password-input, otp-input, currency-input, number-stepper, tag-input, inline-edit
- Confirm, ask, or show a form on top: dialog, alert-dialog (destructive), dialog's Sheet (side drawer), popover
- Tell the user something: toast (transient), alert (inline), banner (page-wide), notification-center (inbox), cookie-consent
- Navigate: sidebar, app-shell, tabs, breadcrumb, pagination, stepper, command (Ctrl K), table-of-contents
- Show KPIs and status: stat-card, gauge, progress, progress-ring, number-ticker, badge, status-dot, charts (Sparkline, BarChart, DonutChart)
- Show people and activity: avatar, timeline, comment-thread, changelog, testimonial-card, rating
- Time: time-picker, analog-clock, world-clock, stopwatch, timer, countdown, relative-time
- Whole pages: blocks: admin-shell, hrms-overview, employee-directory, leave-approvals, leave-request-form, lead-pipeline, campaign-performance, sign-in

## Components (93)

### Layout (2)
- [app-shell](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/app-shell.json): Sidebar, topbar and scrolling content area, plus a page header. Import: AppShell, Topbar, AppContent, PageHeader. Needs befui: sidebar.
- [sidebar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/sidebar.json): Collapsible nav with groups, nested links and badges. Icon rail on desktop, slide-over on mobile. Import: useSidebar, SidebarProvider, SidebarTrigger, Sidebar, SidebarHeader, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarGroup, SidebarItem. Needs befui: dialog, tooltip. npm: lucide-react.

### Navigation (8)
- [breadcrumb](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/breadcrumb.json): Trail of parent pages. Import: Breadcrumb. npm: lucide-react.
- [dock](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/dock.json): Icons that grow toward the pointer, like the macOS dock. Import: Dock.
- [pagination](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/pagination.json): Page buttons with ellipsis for long ranges. Import: Pagination. npm: lucide-react.
- [scroll-progress](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/scroll-progress.json): Thin bar that fills as you scroll the page or a container. Import: ScrollProgress.
- [stepper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/stepper.json): Horizontal steps for multi-step forms and onboarding. Import: Stepper. npm: lucide-react.
- [table-of-contents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/table-of-contents.json): On this page list that highlights the section currently in view. Import: TableOfContents.
- [tabs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/tabs.json): Underline or pill tabs on Radix Tabs. Import: Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent. npm: @radix-ui/react-tabs.
- [tree-view](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/tree-view.json): Nested expandable list with animated open and close. Import: TreeView. npm: lucide-react.

### Inputs (26)
- [button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/button.json): Thirteen variants from plain to glow, shine and 3D press, pill shape, five sizes, loading state, and asChild for links. Import: Button. npm: @radix-ui/react-slot, lucide-react.
- [calendar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/calendar.json): Month grid for one day or a range. Arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home and End work. Import: startOfDay, addDays, addMonths, isSameDay, Calendar. npm: lucide-react.
- [checkbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/checkbox.json): Checked, unchecked and indeterminate. Works for select-all rows. Import: Checkbox. npm: @radix-ui/react-checkbox, lucide-react.
- [chip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/chip.json): Toggleable filter chips, single or multi select. Import: Chip, ChipGroup. npm: lucide-react.
- [color-picker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/color-picker.json): Swatches, hex field and the native picker. Always returns a six-digit hex. Import: ColorPicker. Needs befui: icons.
- [combobox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/combobox.json): Searchable select, single or multiple, with descriptions under each option. Import: Combobox, MultiCombobox. Needs befui: badge, command, popover. npm: lucide-react.
- [copy-button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/copy-button.json): Copies text and morphs to a check. Import: CopyButton. npm: lucide-react.
- [currency-input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/currency-input.json): Money field that groups digits as you type (1,25,000) and hands you a plain number. Import: CurrencyInput.
- [date-picker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/date-picker.json): Date and date range fields that open a calendar. Closes on pick. Import: formatDate, DatePicker, DateRangePicker. Needs befui: calendar, popover. npm: lucide-react.
- [dropzone](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/dropzone.json): Drag and drop file area with size check and removable file list. Import: Dropzone. npm: lucide-react.
- [inline-edit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/inline-edit.json): Text that becomes a field on click. Enter saves, Escape cancels. Import: InlineEdit. Needs befui: icons.
- [input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/input.json): Text input and textarea with icon, trailing slot, and invalid state. Import: Input, Textarea.
- [label](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/label.json): Label with required marker, plus Field for label, control and hint or error. Import: Label, Field. npm: @radix-ui/react-label.
- [number-stepper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/number-stepper.json): Number field with plus and minus buttons and arrow keys. Import: NumberStepper. npm: lucide-react.
- [otp-input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/otp-input.json): Code boxes with paste, backspace, arrow keys, autofill and a shake on error. Import: OtpInput.
- [password-input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/password-input.json): Show and hide toggle with an optional strength meter. Import: passwordScore, PasswordInput. Needs befui: icons, input.
- [radio-group](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/radio-group.json): Native radios as selectable cards with descriptions. Import: RadioGroup.
- [rating](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/rating.json): Star rating with hover preview. Read-only when no handler is given. Import: Rating. npm: lucide-react.
- [search-bar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/search-bar.json): Search field with live results, highlighted matches, recent searches and full keyboard control. Import: SearchBar. Needs befui: icons.
- [search-input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/search-input.json): Search field with a clear button, Escape to clear and a slash shortcut to focus. Import: SearchInput. Needs befui: icons.
- [segmented](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/segmented.json): Pick one of a few views or ranges. Smaller than tabs. Import: Segmented. npm: @radix-ui/react-toggle-group.
- [select](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/select.json): Styled dropdown with groups, built on Radix Select. Import: Select, SelectGroup, SelectValue, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectLabel, SelectItem. npm: @radix-ui/react-select, lucide-react.
- [slider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/slider.json): Native range input with a filled track and floating value bubble. Import: Slider.
- [switch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/switch.json): On/off toggle for settings that apply immediately. Import: Switch. npm: @radix-ui/react-switch.
- [tag-input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/tag-input.json): Type and press Enter to add chips. Backspace removes the last. Import: TagInput. npm: lucide-react.
- [toggle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/toggle.json): Two-state button for favourite, bold or mute. Announces its state to screen readers. Import: Toggle.

## Blocks
- [block:admin-shell](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/block-admin-shell.json): Full app frame: grouped sidebar with nested links, topbar with search, alerts and user menu, and a dashboard page. Uses: app-shell, avatar, breadcrumb, button, calendar, card, charts, date-picker, dropdown-menu, kbd, sidebar, stat-card, timeline.
- [block:campaign-performance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/block-campaign-performance.json): Channel KPIs, weekly leads chart and a campaign budget table. Uses: badge, card, charts, progress, stat-card, table.
- [block:employee-directory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/block-employee-directory.json): Searchable table with status filter, row selection, actions and pagination. Uses: avatar, badge, button, card, checkbox, dropdown-menu, input, pagination, segmented, table.
- [block:hrms-overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/block-hrms-overview.json): Headcount, attendance, department split and activity feed. Uses: avatar, card, charts, stat-card, timeline.
- [block:lead-pipeline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/block-lead-pipeline.json): Drag-and-drop board with column totals and a keyboard-friendly move button. Uses: avatar, badge, button, card, toast.
- [block:leave-approvals](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/block-leave-approvals.json): Manager inbox with tabs, balance bars and approve or reject toasts. Uses: avatar, badge, button, card, empty-state, progress, tabs, toast.
- [block:leave-request-form](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/block-leave-request-form.json): Date range, approver combobox, multi-select notify list, working-day count and field validation. Uses: alert, button, calendar, card, combobox, date-picker, input, label, select, toast.
- [block:sign-in](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/block-sign-in.json): Login card with validation, loading button and an error alert. Uses: alert, button, card, checkbox, input, label.
